traits.leaf_arrangement.note: APweb, Canellales page (read 2026-10-16): Winteraceae spiral, Canellaceae spiral or two-ranked; one leaf per node.

traits.phyllotaxis_pattern.note: APweb, Canellales page (read 2026-10-16): Winteraceae (about 120 spp.) spiral; Canellaceae spiral or two-ranked.

traits.leaf_division.note: APweb, Canellales page (read 2026-10-16): leaves simple, entire.

traits.leaf_habit.note: APweb, Canellales page (read 2026-10-16): both families evergreen trees and shrubs.

traits.life_span.note: APweb, Canellales page (read 2026-10-16): trees, shrubs, a few epiphytes and a liana.

traits.rosette.note: APweb, Canellales page (read 2026-10-16): woody plants with leafy branches; leaves often crowded toward shoot tips but not rosettes.

traits.flowering_position.note: APweb, Canellales page (read 2026-10-16): Winteroideae inflorescences axillary with short axis; Takhtajania terminal; Canellaceae variable.

traits.flower_symmetry.note: APweb, Canellales page (read 2026-10-16): flowers radially symmetric in both families.
